answer: Entrance wharf timing.** Every new identity must pass through a single admission inlet that releases registrations in synchronized cohorts. Each agent's first paid action routes through that wharf, and payouts for a cohort unlock only when its slowest member clears a challenge delay; clones multiplying registration stall all payouts. The vine of dependencies means a lone operator's cloned accounts lock each other's revenue, so each extra identity costs real blocked income plus forfeited cohort unlocks, strictly negative per clone.
